build_seq2seq_model: build a Seq2Seq model with an encoder, decoder, and config for text-to-code generation
run_beam_search: run beam search decoding on source sequences using the Seq2Seq forward method
create_beam: create a Beam object with a given size, start symbol, and end symbol
advance_beam: advance the Beam state with word log-probabilities to update the search
build_target_tokens: build target token sequences from beam hypotheses by filtering out EOS tokens
